title: LoraDiscord
description: A powerful Minecraft-Discord bridge with 2FA admin security, visual profile cards, instant role sync, and chat integration.
body:
# LoraDiscord 🚀

Integrate your Minecraft server with Discord in the most modern and powerful way!

## 🔥 Key Features

### 🛡️ Admin Security Shield (2FA)
- Admins are **automatically frozen** when joining the game
- Login verification sent via **Discord DM**
- Unverified logins result in automatic kick
- Even if your password is stolen, your server stays safe

### 🎒 Visual Profile Cards
- Generate beautiful stat cards with `/profile` command on Discord
- Player's **3D Skin**, playtime, K/D ratio displayed on a **Cyber/Tech** themed image
- Fully customizable and high-quality render

### ⚡ Instant Role Sync
- No constant polling like legacy systems
- Triggers **instantly** when a player joins or **LuckPerms** group changes
- Sync Discord roles with in-game ranks bidirectionally

## 📋 Other Features
- **Account Linking:** Players link accounts with `/verify` and earn rewards
- **Chat Bridge:** In-game chat flows to Discord and vice versa
- **Leaderboards:** Top players, killers, and richest shown on Discord
- **Server Status:** Live player count, TPS, and RAM usage in a pinned Discord message
- **Auto Rewards:** Daily rewards, boost rewards, and vote rewards

## 📦 Requirements
- Java 17+
- Spigot/Paper 1.16+
- (Optional) LuckPerms, Vault, PlaceholderAPI

---

*LoraDiscord is designed to take your server to the next level.*
